def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    n = inputs['n']  # number of people
    k = inputs['k']  # every k-th person is eliminated
    
    # Josephus problem: find survivor position
    # Using 0-indexed positions, then convert to 1-indexed
    positions = list(range(1, n + 1))
    current = 0
    
    while len(positions) > 1:
        # Remove every k-th person (k-1 because we're 0-indexed)
        current = (current + k - 1) % len(positions)
        positions.pop(current)
        # After removal, current points to the next person
        if current >= len(positions) and len(positions) > 0:
            current = 0
    
    return float(positions[0])
